senses.gloss:
y The twenty sixth consonant,
and first of the semivowels.

य (यः-या-यं)
a. Going.
m. Air; union;
fame; light; barley;
Yama. f.
Pudendum; going; checking; a
car; meditation; getting.

या (ल) याति 2.
a. To go, to get.
With अनु to follow; with अभि^1 to ap-
proach; with आ^2 to come; with उप^3 to
give way; with निर्^4 to go forth; with प्र
to go to; with प्रति^5 to go toward;
with प्रति^6 and उत् to go to meet; with सं^7
and with अभि^8 to approach; with सं^9 and
with आ^10 to arrive at.
